instruction_covers: forced_response must populate output_labels, input_labels, and state_labels from the system so that list(res.output_labels) == ['Ia','Wm'] etc.
to_pandas() must work without manually assigning labels (the NoneType iteration error is fixed)
reason: The instruction only describes forced_response label propagation and the resulting to_pandas TypeError, but the hidden tests additionally require label propagation through input_output_response, step_response, impulse_response, and initial_response. Most severely, tests demand that when inputs/outputs are selected (input=/output=), the labels be subset to the selected channels — a behavior the instruction never mentions and that a natural central fix might not implement.
